_comment: List prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, used only to convert MEASURED token counts into money.
Tokens are the ground truth here: they come from the API's own usageMetadata and are recorded
in runs/pareto.json. Prices are editable inputs, not measurements — if these are stale, correct
them and re-run `npm run pareto:report`, which recomputes cost without spending a single call.
Verify against https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing before quoting any dollar figure.
